html: NF-κB, here the p50:p65 dimer, waits in the cytoplasm bound to its inhibitor IκBα. Receptor signals converge on the IKK complex of IKKα, IKKβ and NEMO: TAK1 from the Toll-like receptors, AKT from PI3K and protein kinase C. IKKβ phosphorylates IκBα, which is then ubiquitinated and degraded, and NF-κB enters the nucleus to drive cytokines, chemokines, adhesion molecules and the inflammasome sensor NLRP3.
